description: Parses natural language text to quickly create a basic Google Calendar event with its title, date, and time, suitable for simple scheduling; does not support direct attendee addition or recurring events, and `calendar_id` must be valid if not 'primary'.

text.title: Text
examples: Dentist appointment tomorrow at 2pm for 45 minutes
text.description: Required natural language input describing the event. It must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Google Calendar parses it for event details like title, date, and time.
text.human_parameter_description: Describe the event in plain language (e.g., 'Lunch with Alex tomorrow at 12pm'). Google Calendar will parse this to set the title, date, and time.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Identifier of the calendar for the event. Use 'primary' for the main calendar, or provide a specific calendar ID (e.g., email address).
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar where you want this event to be created. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or provide a specific calendar ID or email address.

send_updates.title: Send Updates
send_updates.description: Controls whether email notifications about the event creation are sent to attendees.
send_updates.human_parameter_description: Choose whether attendees should receive email notifications when the event is created. Select 'all' to notify everyone, 'externalOnly' to notify guests outside your organization, or 'none' for no emails.

iconLink.title: Icon Link
iconLink.description: URL to an icon representing the gadget.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: User preferences specific to the gadget.

id.title: Id
id.description: Attendee's profile ID (Google Workspace). Read-only and optional.

self.title: Self
self.description: Whether the attendee is the calendar where this copy appears.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Whether the attendee is a resource (room).

organizer.title: Organizer
organizer.description: Whether the attendee is the organizer.

delegatedTo.title: Delegated To
delegatedTo.description: Delegatee's email for a delegated invitation.

delegatedFrom.title: Delegated From
delegatedFrom.description: Delegator's email for a delegated invitation.

responseStatus.title: Response Status
responseStatus.description: Attendee's response status: needsAction | declined | tentative | accepted.

proposedNewTime.title: Proposed New Time
proposedNewTime.description: A proposed new time from this attendee.

additionalGuests.title: Additional Guests
additionalGuests.description: Number of additional guests brought by the attendee.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date if this is an all-day event (YYYY-MM-DD).

dateTime.title: Date Time
dateTime.description: The RFC3339 timestamp if this is a timed event.

timeZone.title: Time Zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for start/end time.

self.title: Self
self.description: Whether this person corresponds to the calendar where this copy appears.

email.title: Email
email.description: The person's email address, if available.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: The person's display name, if available.

fileId.title: File Id
fileId.description: ID of the attached file (Drive attachments).

iconLink.title: Icon Link
iconLink.description: URL to a small icon for the attachment.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Opaque signature to verify conference data.

conferenceId.title: Conference Id
conferenceId.description: Identifier for the conference (e.g., Meet code).

createRequest.title: Create Request
createRequest.description: Request and status for creating a conference.

event.title: Event
event.description: Event resource returned by Google Calendar API Events: quickAdd. Includes fields like kind, etag, id, status, htmlLink, created/updated timestamps, start/end (date/dateTime), creator/organizer, iCalUID, eventType, sequence, reminders, and more.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the event in Google Calendar's web UI

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes before the start of the event when the reminder triggers.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the conference solution.

iconUri.title: Icon Uri
iconUri.description: Icon URI for the conference solution.

chatStatus.title: Chat Status
chatStatus.description: User's chat status during focus time.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Custom decline message during focus time.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive end time; either date (all-day) or dateTime (timed).

start.title: Start
start.description: Inclusive start time; either date (all-day) or dateTime (timed).

gadget.title: Gadget
gadget.description: A gadget associated with the event (deprecated).

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Whether event is locked and cannot be modified by attendees.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source from which the event was created.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status of the event: confirmed | tentative | cancelled.

colorId.title: Color Id
colorId.description: Color ID of the event from the calendar's palette.

created.title: Created
created.description: Creation time of the event (RFC3339 timestamp). Read-only.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: The creator of the event. Read-only.

iCalUID.title: I Cal Uid
iCalUID.description: Event identifier in iCalendar format. Read-only.

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: Last modification time of the event (RFC3339 timestamp). Read-only.

htmlLink.title: Html Link
htmlLink.description: Absolute link to the Google Calendar Web UI for this event.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Sequence number as per iCalendar. Increments on changes.

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.description: List of attendees of the event.

eventType.title: Event Type
eventType.description: Type of the event: default | fromGmail | outOfOffice | focusTime | workingLocation.

organizer.title: Organizer
organizer.description: The organizer of the event. Read-only.

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.description: List of RRULE/EXRULE/RDATE/EXDATE lines for a recurring event (RFC5545).

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the event. May contain HTML.

hangoutLink.title: Hangout Link
hangoutLink.description: Link to the Google Meet for the event. Read-only.

privateCopy.title: Private Copy
privateCopy.description: Whether this is a private copy intended for the authenticated user.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Opaque (blocks time) or transparent (does not block).

conferenceData.title: Conference Data
conferenceData.description: Conference info associated with the event.

guestsCanModify.title: Guests Can Modify
guestsCanModify.description: Whether attendees other than organizer can modify the event.

anyoneCanAddSelf.title: Anyone Can Add Self
anyoneCanAddSelf.description: Whether anyone can invite themselves (non-private events).

attendeesOmitted.title: Attendees Omitted
attendeesOmitted.description: Whether attendees were omitted to protect privacy.

recurringEventId.title: Recurring Event Id
recurringEventId.description: For an instance, ID of the recurring series to which this event belongs.

originalStartTime.title: Original Start Time
originalStartTime.description: For an instance, time at which this event would start per recurrence.

endTimeUnspecified.title: End Time Unspecified
endTimeUnspecified.description: Whether the end time is unspecified. If true, only start is meaningful.

focusTimeProperties.title: Focus Time Properties
focusTimeProperties.description: Properties specific to focus time events.

guestsCanInviteOthers.title: Guests Can Invite Others
guestsCanInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than organizer can invite others.

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.title: Guests Can See Other Guests
guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees can see each other's attendees list.

workingLocationProperties.title: Working Location Properties
workingLocationProperties.description: Properties specific to working location events.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Custom decline message when auto-declining invitations.

autoDeclineMode.title: Auto Decline Mode
autoDeclineMode.description: Auto-decline behavior during OOO (e.g., decline all or based on contacts).

status.title: Status
status.description: Status of the conference create request.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Client-generated unique ID for create request.

conferenceSolutionKey.title: Conference Solution Key
conferenceSolutionKey.description: Identifies the conference solution to use.

type.title: Type
type.description: Working location type: homeOffice | officeLocation | customLocation.

customLocation.title: Custom Location
customLocation.description: Details for a custom working location.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
